books.title: Demian
books.author: Hermann Hesse
books.description: The story of Emil Sinclair's journey from innocence to self-discovery, guided by the mysterious Max Demian. A foundational influence on BTS's Wings era — RM has cited it as one of the books that shaped him most deeply.

books.title: Siddhartha
books.author: Hermann Hesse
books.description: A novel following Siddhartha's spiritual journey in ancient India, seeking enlightenment through experience rather than doctrine. One of Hesse's most beloved works and a natural companion to Demian.
books.source: Catalogued in fan and library compilations of his documented reads

books.title: Norwegian Wood
books.author: Haruki Murakami
books.description: A melancholic coming-of-age story set in 1960s Tokyo, exploring grief, memory, and love. RM shared a page from this novel on his Instagram story in October 2022.

books.title: Kafka on the Shore
books.author: Haruki Murakami
books.description: Two parallel narratives weave together in Murakami's surrealist masterpiece — a teenage runaway and an elderly man who can talk to cats. One of Murakami's most celebrated novels.
books.source: Catalogued in fan and library compilations of his documented reads

books.title: 1Q84
books.author: Haruki Murakami

books.title: Killing Commendatore
books.author: Haruki Murakami

books.title: Almost Transparent Blue

books.title: Kitchen

books.title: Honeybees and Distant Thunder
